app.name: Voltship
app.tagline: Your products, quotes, stock and research — in one place.

landing.headline:
Your catalog,
classified.
landing.sub: Winning products, live quotes, days of stock left, inbound QC, and research — one login. No Airtable. No guesswork.

statuses.title: Classified every night from your Shopify sales

stats.title: Built for scale
stats.sub: Trusted by e-commerce founders managing high-volume operations across Europe and beyond.

landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need after the factory.
landing.featuresSub: From sourcing to stock alerts — manage your entire product lifecycle without spreadsheets.

library.title: Product library
library.body: Photo-first cards auto-classified nightly. Filter by lifecycle, search by name — your catalog at a glance.

quote.title: Quote & COGS
quote.body: Unit price, real carrier name, shipping to your markets. Accept a quote in one click — no back and forth.

stock.title: Stock & restock
stock.body: Days-of-stock-left, safety thresholds, and clear alerts before you stock out. Restock requests in-app.

research.title: Research packs
research.body: Product briefs, Reddit deep-dives, persona cards. AI-generated — delivered to your dashboard.

economics.title: Unit economics
economics.body: ROAS break-even, multiplier, available profit per sale. Type a selling price — see every number update live.

notifications.title: Smart notifications
notifications.body: In-app, email, or WhatsApp. Quote ready, stock alert, lifecycle change — your rules, your channels.

quote.badge: Estimated — billed on real packed weight
quote.sectionTitle: A quote you can actually read.
quote.sectionBody: Four numbers. Real carrier name. No internal margin split. When rates move, you see the new COGS on your next visit.
quote.benefit1Body: One client price. Real carrier. No hidden tiers.
quote.benefit2Body: Grid updates cascade instantly. No surprises.
quote.benefit3Body: Accept and move on. We handle the rest.

workflow.title: From brief to stock in five steps.
workflow.sub: The entire product lifecycle — tracked, visible, and always up to date.

brief.title: Submit a brief
brief.body: Describe the product, upload a photo, set a target price. No external forms.

source.title: Voltship sources
source.body: Our sourcing team finds factories, negotiates, and sends you a quote.

accept.title: Accept the quote
accept.body: Review COGS, carrier, and delivery time. Accept in one click.

produce.title: Production & QC
produce.body: Track production, receive QC photos, see inbound shipments.

sell.title: Sell & restock
sell.body: Monitor sales velocity, days left, and restock before you run out.

close.title:
Your space is ready
when Voltship invites you.
close.body: Sign in with the email we sent. Your catalog, quotes, stock, and research are waiting.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.lead: Sign in with the email Voltship invited. This is your company workspace — not the Voltship admin console.
auth.signupLead: Create your company workspace, then sign in.
auth.signupLeadFirst: This first account is the Voltship admin. You can invite clients after.
auth.firstAdminHint: No admin exists yet. This account will be voltship_admin.
auth.signupAside:
Create your space.
Then your products.
auth.inviteOnly: Ask Voltship if you need access.
auth.missingConfig: Supabase is not configured. Add keys to .env.local.
auth.staffLead: Admin and sourcing only. Client companies use the client portal.
auth.staffAsideLead: Internal Voltship console. Clients never sign in here.
auth.wrongPortalStaff: This login is for client companies. Voltship staff should use the staff sign-in.
auth.wrongPortalClient: This login is for Voltship staff. Client companies should use the client sign-in.
auth.forgotLead: Enter the email on your Voltship admin account. We will send a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If that email belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way. Open it in this browser.
auth.forgotError: Could not send the reset link. Try again.
auth.resetLead: Set a new password for your admin account.
auth.resetMissingSession: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.resetError: Could not update the password. Request a new link and try again.
auth.staffSignupLead: Create a Voltship admin account, then continue into the admin console.
auth.staffSignupAside:
A new admin sign-in.
The same console.

products.title: Your products
products.lead: 90-day sales, gross margin, days of stock, COGS and ROAS per product.
products.empty: No products yet. Drop a new product to start sourcing.

pipeline.lead: Products your sourcer is working on.

warehouse.title: Warehouse orders
warehouse.lead: Latest orders pushed to the ECCANG warehouse: status, carrier, tracking and billed weight.
warehouse.empty: No order pushed to the warehouse yet.

products.title: Products
products.lead: Your library, ranked from your Shopify sales. Open a card for the quote, stock and unit economics.
products.newLead: A link or a photo is enough. We visit the factories, negotiate, and you get a clear quote.

pipeline.caption: Sourcing progress — Voltship updates this as work moves forward.

products.empty: No products yet. Use New product — that replaces the old Airtable form.
products.migrationHint: Run supabase/migrations/00002_app_tables.sql so the product library can save.

form.name: Product name
form.natureHint: Tick what applies — it helps us pick the right shipping line.
form.attrAlcohol: Is it a perfume or does it contain alcohol?
form.attrAlcoholEx: perfume, eau de toilette, alcohol-based lotion
form.approxWeight: Approximate unit weight, if you know it
form.currentUnitCost: What you pay today per unit at your agent, if you want an estimate
form.currentUnitCostEx: we show an estimated COGS before sourcing even starts

quote.title: Landed cost
quote.pending: Pending sourcing data — unit price, weight and channel are filled by Voltship.
quote.accepted: Quote accepted. Voltship has been notified.
quote.acceptHint: Accept becomes available once Voltship fills unit price, weight and channel.
quote.question: Send question
quote.questionPlaceholder: Ask about the quote, factory, or timing — this is a note, not a chat.
quote.missingGrid: The pricing grid is not active yet.
quote.missingRate: No {destination} rate matches this weight and channel yet.
quote.earlyTitle: Estimated COGS · to be confirmed by sourcing
quote.earlyLead: Computed on the active grid from your answers: {channel} channel, {weight} g, {cost} per unit ({source}). No Voltship sourcing commission applied. This is not a quote.
quote.earlyNoPrice: Set a Shopify selling price to see the estimated ROAS.
quote.earlyMissingGrid: Rate grid not active yet — estimate unavailable.
quote.earlyMissingRate: No rate matches this weight and channel — estimate unavailable.

stock.title: Stock
stock.notesPlaceholder: Target date, market, or MOQ note
stock.stockout: Out of stock since {date}. About {units} units missed at the recent sales pace.

lifecycleBanner.winning: This product is winning. Secure the next batch before stock runs out.
lifecycleBanner.testing: Generate a research pack while this product is in testing.
lifecycleBanner.declining: Stock covers about {days} days at the current pace. Review before restocking.
lifecycleBanner.decliningUnknown: Sales have slowed. Review stock before restocking.
lifecycleBanner.dead: Free storage is ending. Ask Voltship about clearance options.

drop.title: You drop the product
drop.body: A link or a photo, two minutes.

validate.title: You validate the quote, we launch

cogsMatrix.title: COGS 1–5 × market
cogsMatrix.lead: Cost of goods for an order of 1 to 5 units, per market — live grid, one parcel per order.
cogsMatrix.missingGrid: The rate grid is not active yet.
cogsMatrix.missingProduct: Price, weight and channel are filled in by Voltship — the matrix shows up after that.
cogsMatrix.formulaNote: COGS(n) = n × product price (+ commission) + shipping for one parcel of n × unit weight + handling once per order. The accepted quote stays the contractual figure for 1 unit.
cogsMatrix.roasNote: Break-even ROAS, then target ROAS at {margin}% margin, computed on the AOV (selling price × n) and the order COGS.

recurrence.label: Re-purchase:
recurrence.noSku: no SKU linked to Shopify orders.
recurrence.noBuyers: no identified buyer in the cached Shopify orders.
recurrence.value: {rate} of {buyers} buyers re-ordered (any product) within {days} days.

carrier.title: Carrier
carrier.lead: Pick the line that ships this product on each market — price and delay for 1 unit, live grid. The cheapest line is applied by default.
carrier.noOption: No line covers this weight on this market.
carrier.fallbackHint: Chosen line unavailable at this weight → cheapest applied
carrier.note: The chosen line drives the COGS, the matrix and the warehouse shipment. The accepted quote stays frozen.
carrier.readOnly: Only members of your workspace can change the line.

economics.title: Unit economics
economics.note: Fees {fees}% (your profile) · target ROAS = {target}% margin · indicative estimate.

inbound.title: Inbound
inbound.lead: Your goods on their way to the warehouse: announced, arrived, checked, stocked.
inbound.empty: No inbound yet — warehouse receipts will appear here as soon as we open.
inbound.emptyLive: No inbound shipment yet. Launch a restock from a product page: the receiving notice will show up here as soon as the warehouse creates it.

notificationsPage.title: Notifications
notificationsPage.lead: Quotes, stock, research and lifecycle changes.
notificationsPage.empty: Nothing yet. Events will land here, and also go to email or WhatsApp.
notificationsPage.unreadCount: {count, plural, =1 {1 unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Set your financial profile once. Every product page uses it for ROAS and profit.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can edit the financial profile.
settings.stockLead: Safety buffer is extra days added to the restock window. Coverage target is how many days of stock a reorder should cover.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lead: Choose how each event reaches you. In-app stays in this workspace. Email and WhatsApp send when Voltship delivery is connected.

settings.financialLead: Fees, target margins and safety buffer used for ROAS and restock alerts.

shopify.title: Shopify store
shopify.lead: Connect your store so Voltship tracks your sales and stock automatically.
shopify.access: Products, orders, shipments and inventory — Voltship never edits your orders.
shopify.connectedBanner: Store connected. The last 90 days of orders and your catalogue are being imported.
shopify.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can connect or disconnect a store.

apiKeys.title: API & support integrations
apiKeys.lead: Give your support tool (Repline, Gorgias, Zendesk…) read access to your order tracking.
apiKeys.newKeyLead: It will never be shown again. Store it in your support tool.
apiKeys.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can manage API keys.
apiKeys.limit: 60 requests / minute per key. Statuses: received, preparing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, unknown.

gmail.title: Support · Gmail inbox
gmail.lead: Connect your support Gmail inbox: customer e-mails show up in the Support tab with the matched order and a suggested reply.
gmail.connectedBanner: Gmail inbox connected. The first sync (last 7 days) runs within 10 minutes.
gmail.notConfigured: Gmail is not configured on the Voltship side (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID).
gmail.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can connect or disconnect the inbox.
gmail.scopes: Requested access: read e-mails and send replies (gmail.modify). Customer addresses are never stored in clear text.

admin.title: Clients
admin.lead: Create a tenant, invite users, set the plan, or view the app as that client.
admin.empty: No clients yet. Create one — then invite an owner so they can sign in to their workspace.
admin.newLead: One company = one tenant. Language and plan are set here.
admin.planHelp: Changes the entitlements default and logistics discount. Displayed COGS will follow once pricing is live.
admin.inviteHelp: They sign in with this email. If you leave the password blank, we generate one — copy it now.
admin.inviteDone: User invited. They can sign in with the password you set.

dashboard.title: Operations dashboard
dashboard.lead: Clients, sourcing, pricing, and integration health at a glance.

recentProducts.title: Latest product requests
recentProducts.lead: Newest work entering the sourcing pipeline.

restock.title: Restock threshold
restock.lead: SKUs across clients that are at or below safety stock.
restock.empty: No SKUs are under the restock threshold.

recentClients.title: Recent clients
recentClients.empty: No clients have been created yet.

rateImport.title: Update rates with the assistant
rateImport.lead: Drop a carrier price list in any form — Claude turns it into a versioned grid, applies the Voltship margin rule, and you activate it after review.
rateImport.notConfigured: The rate assistant is not configured (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

step1.title: 1 · Price list
step1.lead: PDF, screenshot (JPEG/PNG), Excel matrix (.xlsx — one sheet per country × category, carriers as columns, weight in g as rows), CSV or pasted text — up to 3 files of 8 MB. RMB price lists per kg + fee or per weight bracket.
step1.hintPlaceholder: VIP grid of 24/09, Europe lines only…

paths.assistant: PDF, screenshot, pasted text or a carrier's own price list — the assistant reads and structures it, with a confidence score.
paths.matrix: your China_Carriers_Matrix file (.xlsx, one sheet per COUNTRY-CATEGORY, gram-by-gram weights) is read without AI: every carrier at once, 50 g brackets priced at the max gram. Auto-detected from the sheet names.

step1.matrixHelp: Forces the direct .xlsx read (no Claude). Otherwise the matrix is detected automatically when a sheet is named FRANCE-STANDARD, USA-ELECTRONICS…

step2.title: 2 · Review
step2.lead: Check every line, toggle the tax flag or exclude a line, adjust the margin rule, then activate.
step2.vatExtra: VAT on declared value billed extra — excluded by default

settings.title: Margin rule
settings.lead: price = cost € + max(cost € × margin %, min margin) + EU tax when not tax-inclusive, rounded to 0.05.

comparison.title: Before / after — cheapest carrier
comparison.lead: Reference weights per destination and channel. Other carriers from the active grid stay in place; the imported carrier is replaced.
comparison.empty: No comparison yet — include at least one line.

activate.title: Activate the grid
activate.lead: Creates a new grid version containing these cells plus every other carrier of the active grid, activates it for every live quote, and logs the change. Accepted quotes stay frozen.
activate.confirmLow: I checked the low-confidence lines and want to activate anyway.
activate.confirm: Activate this grid now? Every live quote will use it.

step2.allInclusive: All-inclusive matrix: every price is the final carrier cost per parcel — no tax or supplement is added and every line competes for the cheapest pick. IOSS mentions are informational.

margin.title: Voltship margin
margin.lead: What clients pay vs what it costs Voltship, over the last {days} days (parcels shipped through ECCANG).
margin.formula: Margin = (product + commission − factory price) + (client shipping − carrier cost − EU tax passed on) + (handling fee − real cost). FX at {fx} RMB/€; estimated FX gain vs {fxMarket}.

byClient.title: By client
byClient.lead: ECCANG parcels shipped over the window, priced with the active grid and the sourcing factory prices.
byClient.empty: No parcel shipped through ECCANG over the window. Per-product margins stay visible on each client page.

flags.carrier_cost_unknown: carrier cost unknown, grid imported before the assistant

clientCard.title: Voltship margin
clientCard.lead: Per product, 1 unit on the primary market, active grid. Factory prices come from sourcing (never visible to the client).
clientCard.weightedBySales: Total weighted by the last {days} days of sales.
clientCard.perUnit: No sales over {days} days: total per unit (1 per product).
clientCard.noGrid: No active grid: margins cannot be computed.

productPage.lead: Client price vs Voltship cost vs margin, per market and quantity (1 to 5 units in one parcel).
productPage.factoryMissing: Factory price missing in sourcing — the sourcing margin is not computed.

margin.settingsNote: Handling cost {handling} · FX {fx} RMB/€ · market rate {fxMarket} — editable in Pricing › Update rates › Margin rule.

finance.title: Week-by-week result
finance.lead: Parcels shipped, client revenue, variable costs, fixed costs and result over the last {weeks} ISO weeks (Monday → Sunday, Paris time).
finance.formula: Result = (client revenue − variable costs) − fixed costs of the week. Monthly fixed costs × 12/52. Break-even = fixed costs ÷ average margin per parcel.

chart.title: Weekly result
chart.lead: Green: positive week. Rust: negative week. Hatched: estimated (Shopify orders, no ECCANG shipment).

table.title: Last {weeks} weeks
table.lead: Click a week to see the per-client split.

byClient.title: Per client
byClient.lead: Parcels valued with the active grid and the sourcing factory prices.

finance.caveat: Margin per parcel = Voltship margin engine (product + commission − factory, shipping − carrier − tax pass-through, handling fee − cost). Parcels without a factory price or carrier cost are partial. This is not accounting: VAT, real FX and payroll charges are not modelled.

costs.title: Fixed costs & adjustments
costs.lead: Rent, salaries, tools… prorated per week; one-off adjustments attached to a week.
costs.addLead: Monthly: × 12/52 per week. Weekly: as is. One-off: counted in the week of the start date.
costs.empty: No fixed cost yet. The result equals the gross margin.

adjustments.addLead: A refund, a bonus billed to a client, a damaged parcel… signed amount, attached to the week of the date.

impersonate.banner: Viewing as {client}. Writes are audit-logged as you.

sourcer.title: Sourcing queue
sourcer.soon: Oldest requests first. Complete the quote fields and send the client-ready COGS.

support.title: Support
support.lead: Your customer e-mails, the matched order and a suggested reply to review before sending.
support.empty: No ticket yet. Connect your Gmail inbox in Settings to get started.

thread.draftLead: Review, edit, then send. Nothing goes out without your click.
thread.noDraft: No suggested reply (AI assistant not configured or pending). Write your reply below.
